test_principle: Colloidal-gold immunochromatography (lateral flow). The device captures the target analyte (antigen or antibody) on a membrane via labeled antibodies, producing a visible test line within minutes. Qualitative or semi-quantitative, intended as a screening/triage aid — not a replacement for confirmatory laboratory testing.

dengue-ns1.intended_use: Qualitative detection of Dengue NS1 antigen for early diagnosis of dengue virus infection.
dengue-ns1.clinical_context: NS1 antigen is detectable from day 1 of fever through early convalescence — before IgM reliably appears. NS1 antigen tests are most useful in the first week of illness (WHO recommends combined NS1 + IgM testing to cover acute and later phases).
dengue-ns1.limitations: Sensitivity varies by serotype and timing; a negative NS1 does not rule out dengue. Confirm with serology or RT-PCR when clinically indicated.
dengue-ns1.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

dengue-igg-igm.intended_use: Qualitative detection of Dengue IgM and IgG antibodies for serological diagnosis of dengue.
dengue-igg-igm.clinical_context: IgM appears ~3–5 days after fever onset; IgG indicates past exposure or secondary infection. Combined IgM/IgG is standard for late-acute and convalescent dengue serology.
dengue-igg-igm.limitations: Cross-reactivity with Zika and other flaviviruses is possible; interpret serology with travel and vaccination history.
dengue-igg-igm.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

dengue-combo.intended_use: Combined detection of Dengue NS1 antigen and IgM/IgG antibodies in a single device.
dengue-combo.clinical_context: The NS1 + IgM/IgG combo widens the diagnostic window — capturing early (NS1) and later (IgM/IgG) phases in one test, improving case detection across the illness course.
dengue-combo.limitations: Same flavivirus cross-reactivity caveats as serology; combo results still require clinical correlation.
dengue-combo.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

malaria-pf.intended_use: Detection of Plasmodium falciparum HRP2 antigen for malaria diagnosis.
malaria-pf.clinical_context: HRP2 is specific to P. falciparum (the most severe malaria species). WHO-recommended rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) are standard in settings without microscopy.
malaria-pf.limitations: HRP2 can persist for weeks after treatment; HRP2 gene deletions can cause false negatives in some regions. Species-specific — does not detect P. vivax.
malaria-pf.procurement: Specimen: whole blood. Format: dipstick / cassette. CE-marked line.

malaria-pf-pan.intended_use: Detection of P. falciparum (HRP2) and Pan-Plasmodium (pLDH) antigen for species differentiation.
malaria-pf-pan.clinical_context: Combines Pf-specific HRP2 with Pan LDH (detects all human malaria species) — enables Pf vs non-Pf differentiation in one device, aligned with WHO RDT guidance.
malaria-pf-pan.limitations: Cannot distinguish P. vivax from P. ovale/malariae; HRP2 persistence caveats apply.
malaria-pf-pan.procurement: Specimen: whole blood. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

malaria-pf-pv.intended_use: Detection of P. falciparum and P. vivax antigens for malaria species differentiation.
malaria-pf-pv.clinical_context: Targets the two most common malaria species. Useful where both P. falciparum and P. vivax are endemic.
malaria-pf-pv.limitations: Limited to Pf/Pv; other species require microscopy or Pan tests.
malaria-pf-pv.procurement: Specimen: whole blood. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

hiv-12.intended_use: Detection of antibodies to HIV-1 and HIV-2 in blood.
hiv-12.clinical_context: HIV antibody tests detect immune response to infection; standard first-line screening. WHO testing strategies use serial antibody tests with confirmation.
hiv-12.limitations: A reactive result is presumptive and must be confirmed per national algorithm; antibody tests miss very early infection (window period).
hiv-12.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette / dipstick. Registration in progress (Non-CE per current catalog).

hbsag.intended_use: Detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) for HBV infection screening.
hbsag.clinical_context: HBsAg is the earliest viral antigen marker of acute HBV and a marker of chronic infection. Widely used in blood-bank and antenatal screening.
hbsag.limitations: Reactive results require confirmatory testing (neutralization / HBV DNA); does not distinguish acute from chronic.
hbsag.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette / strip. Registration in progress.

hcv.intended_use: Detection of antibodies to Hepatitis C virus.
hcv.clinical_context: Anti-HCV indicates exposure (current or past infection). Standard first-line screen; active infection is confirmed by HCV RNA.
hcv.limitations: A positive antibody result does not confirm active infection — reflex to HCV RNA is required.
hcv.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette / strip. Registration in progress.

hpylori-ab.intended_use: Detection of H. pylori antibodies in serum/plasma/whole blood.
hpylori-ab.clinical_context: Serology indicates exposure but cannot distinguish active from past infection; used where endoscopy or stool testing is unavailable.
hpylori-ab.limitations: Not recommended alone for test-and-treat decisions after treatment (antibodies persist); prefer stool antigen or urea breath test for active infection.
hpylori-ab.procurement: Specimen: WB / S / P. Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

hpylori-ag.intended_use: Detection of H. pylori antigen in feces for active infection.
hpylori-ag.clinical_context: Stool antigen detects active H. pylori infection; suitable for diagnosis and post-treatment confirmation (non-invasive).
hpylori-ag.limitations: Sensitivity can be affected by recent PPI/antibiotic use; confirm equivocal results.
hpylori-ag.procurement: Specimen: feces. Format: cassette / dipstick, 25 T. CE-marked line.

syphilis.intended_use: Detection of Treponema pallidum antibodies for syphilis screening.
syphilis.clinical_context: Treponemal antibody tests detect immune response to T. pallidum. Used in antenatal and blood-donor screening and STD programs.
syphilis.limitations: Treponemal tests remain positive after treated infection — cannot distinguish active from past; confirm with non-treponemal (RPR) titer.
syphilis.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette / dipstick. CE-marked line.

strep-a.intended_use: Detection of Group A Streptococcus antigen from throat swab for pharyngitis.
strep-a.clinical_context: Rapid antigen detection tests (RADT) for Strep A support point-of-care diagnosis of streptococcal pharyngitis, aiding antibiotic stewardship.
strep-a.limitations: Negative RADT may require throat culture in children/adolescents per guidelines; sensitivity lower than culture.
strep-a.procurement: Specimen: throat swab. Format: dipstick / cassette. CE-marked line.

influenza-ab.intended_use: Detection of Influenza A and B nucleoprotein antigens from respiratory specimens.
influenza-ab.clinical_context: Rapid influenza antigen tests support seasonal respiratory diagnosis. Antigen tests are faster but less sensitive than molecular methods.
influenza-ab.limitations: A negative antigen result during high prevalence does not exclude influenza; molecular confirmation may be needed.
influenza-ab.procurement: Specimen: swab / nasal aspirate. Format: dipstick / cassette. CE-marked line.

covid-ag.intended_use: Detection of SARS-CoV-2 antigen (nucleocapsid) from nasal/nasopharyngeal swab.
covid-ag.clinical_context: Rapid antigen tests (RATs) detect active SARS-CoV-2 infection; most sensitive when viral load is high (early symptomatic phase).
covid-ag.limitations: Less sensitive than RT-PCR, especially asymptomatic/low viral load; repeat testing is often recommended.
covid-ag.procurement: Specimen: NP / nasal swab. Format: device, 20 T. CE-marked line.

covid-flu-rsv.intended_use: Combined detection of SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A/B and RSV antigens.
covid-flu-rsv.clinical_context: Multiplex respiratory antigen panel for syndromic differentiation of the three major winter respiratory viruses in one test.
covid-flu-rsv.limitations: Antigen-test sensitivity limits apply to each target; confirm negatives clinically as needed.
covid-flu-rsv.procurement: Specimen: nasopharyngeal swab. Format: cassette, 20 T. CE-marked line.

troponin-i.intended_use: Detection of cardiac troponin I for myocardial injury assessment.
troponin-i.clinical_context: Cardiac troponin is the preferred biomarker for acute myocardial infarction; rapid assays support point-of-care triage in chest-pain evaluation.
troponin-i.limitations: Qualitative/semi-quantitative POC assays are for triage — not a substitute for high-sensitivity quantitative lab assays; serial testing required.
troponin-i.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

ck-mb.intended_use: Detection of CK-MB isoenzyme for myocardial injury.
ck-mb.clinical_context: CK-MB is a cardiac marker with a later rise than troponin; largely superseded by troponin but still used in some protocols.
ck-mb.limitations: Lower cardiac specificity than troponin; interpret with troponin and clinical context.
ck-mb.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

myoglobin.intended_use: Detection of myoglobin for early myocardial injury.
myoglobin.clinical_context: Myoglobin rises earliest after myocardial injury but has low cardiac specificity; used as an early marker in some multi-marker panels.
myoglobin.limitations: Low specificity (elevated in skeletal muscle injury/renal failure); not used alone.
myoglobin.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette, 25 T. CE-marked line.

d-dimer.intended_use: Detection of D-dimer for fibrinolysis/thrombosis assessment.
d-dimer.clinical_context: D-dimer is a fibrin-degradation product; a negative result helps rule out venous thromboembolism (VTE) in low-risk patients.
d-dimer.limitations: Positive D-dimer is non-specific (elevated in many conditions); used for exclusion, not diagnosis.
d-dimer.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / plasma. Format: cassette / strip, 25 T. CE-marked line.

crp.intended_use: Semi-quantitative detection of C-reactive protein for inflammation.
crp.clinical_context: CRP is an acute-phase protein; rapid CRP supports infection/inflammation triage and antibiotic-stewardship decisions in primary care.
crp.limitations: Non-specific — elevated in many inflammatory conditions; semi-quantitative POC results are triage-grade.
crp.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: strip / cassette. CE-marked line.

hcg.intended_use: Detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) for pregnancy.
hcg.clinical_context: hCG is the standard pregnancy hormone; rapid tests detect early pregnancy from urine or serum.
hcg.limitations: Very early or ectopic pregnancy may give low/negative results; confirm clinically.
hcg.procurement: Specimen: urine / serum. Format: dipstick / midstream / cassette. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

lh.intended_use: Detection of luteinizing hormone (LH) surge for ovulation prediction.
lh.clinical_context: The LH surge precedes ovulation by ~24–36 hours; LH tests support fertility tracking.
lh.limitations: Not a contraceptive; some conditions (PCOS) cause persistently elevated LH.
lh.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: dipstick / device. CE-marked line.

psa.intended_use: Detection of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) for prostate cancer screening support.
psa.clinical_context: PSA is a prostate biomarker used in screening and monitoring; elevated PSA prompts further evaluation (biopsy).
psa.limitations: Elevated PSA is not specific to cancer (BPH, prostatitis); POC semi-quantitative results are screening-grade.
psa.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette / strip. CE-marked line.

afp.intended_use: Detection of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) for hepatocellular carcinoma screening support.
afp.clinical_context: AFP is a tumor marker associated with hepatocellular carcinoma; used in high-risk surveillance and monitoring.
afp.limitations: Not diagnostic alone — imaging and confirmatory testing required; elevated in other liver conditions.
afp.procurement: Specimen: whole blood / serum / plasma. Format: cassette. CE-marked line.

doa-thc.intended_use: Detection of Δ9-THC-COOH (cannabis metabolite) in urine for drug screening.
doa-thc.clinical_context: Workplace and clinical drug-of-abuse screening. Cut-off typically 50 ng/mL.
doa-thc.limitations: Screening result — presumptive positive requires confirmatory (GC-MS/LC-MS).
doa-thc.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

doa-coc.intended_use: Detection of benzoylecgonine (cocaine metabolite) in urine.
doa-coc.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

doa-amp.limitations: Cross-reactivity with some sympathomimetics possible; confirm positives.
doa-amp.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

doa-met.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

doa-mop.limitations: Positive may reflect prescription opiates; confirm to identify source.
doa-mop.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

doa-opi.limitations: Class-level test — confirm specific opiate by lab method.
doa-opi.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line.

doa-bzo.limitations: Cross-reactivity varies by benzodiazepine; confirm positives.
doa-bzo.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cassette / dipstick / panel. CE-marked line (FDA status per product on request).

doa-multi-panel.intended_use: Integrated multi-drug screening cup (2–14 analytes) with adulteration checks.
doa-multi-panel.clinical_context: Workplace and clinical multi-panel screening with built-in adulteration strips (pH, specific gravity, oxidants).
doa-multi-panel.limitations: Panel is presumptive; any positive analyte requires confirmatory testing.
doa-multi-panel.procurement: Specimen: urine. Format: cup, 2–14 panel. CE-marked line.
